01 / The context

A problem worth exploring.

University of Michigan students need an easier way to meet new friends beyond their existing circles.

A website and iOS app that help University of Michigan students make new friends. Groups are formed around user preferences and refresh every Thursday at 10:30 AM, with built-in chat to keep the conversation going.
